files.label: THE FROZEN CANAL
files.must_show: The recognizable Rialto Bridge spans an icy Venice Grand Canal, with snow on its stone arch and historic palazzi.
files.observed_subject: A snow-covered Rialto Bridge with its central arch and shops dominates above a frozen Grand Canal, flanked by Venetian palazzi.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: GONDOLA SUNSET
files.must_show: The recognizable Rialto Bridge spans Venice Grand Canal behind a red velvet gondola at sunset.
files.observed_subject: The Rialto Bridge is clearly visible over the Grand Canal behind a foreground gondola with red velvet cushions and a lantern at sunset.

files.name: 03.png

files.must_show: The recognizable Rialto Bridge spans Venice Grand Canal behind a wisteria-covered waterside cafe.
files.observed_subject: The recognizable Rialto Bridge dominates the Grand Canal beyond a wisteria-draped waterside cafe and ornate gondola.

files.name: 04.png

files.must_show: The recognizable Rialto Bridge spans Venice Grand Canal and is covered with green vines and flowering foliage.
files.observed_subject: The Rialto Bridge dominates the canal, its stone structure covered in green vines, with dense foliage and lotus flowers in the foreground.

files.name: 05.png

files.observed_subject: The illuminated Rialto Bridge spans the Grand Canal beyond a moored red-upholstered gondola, striped posts and purple blossoms.
